text: boardwise-dsh 是面向 DSH 的硬件设计工具插件：通过注册工具把 Boardwise 的本机 CLI 接入 DSH，并以本地 connector 连接 EasyEDA Pro。它可对导出的设计文件或编辑器中的工程生成检查报告、读取报告章节、收集实时证据并批量标注警告，也提供架构骨架、本机诊断、离线电路绘图编译和绘图回放检查。适合使用 DSH 辅助原理图与 PCB 设计审阅、整理审查结果或编译绘图的硬件工程师。需在本机安装 Boardwise CLI；实时工程功能还需 EasyEDA Pro 与 connector。

boardwise-dsh adds Boardwise design tools to DSH. It calls the local CLI to review exported or live EasyEDA Pro designs, read reports, collect evidence, triage findings, and compile or replay circuit drawings offline. Install the Boardwise CLI; live review also requires the EasyEDA connector.

I want DSH to review an EasyEDA Pro design and return a structured report.

boardwise-dsh 的功能「设计检查」：调用 boardwise_checkup 检查一个导出的 .epro2/.enet 文件或指定的编辑器工程，并返回报告路径、命令输出和退出状态。
boardwise-dsh 的功能「报告读取与证据」：按结论、发现、覆盖等章节读取已有报告，也可通过本地 bridge 收集实时原理图或 PCB 证据并合入报告。
boardwise-dsh 的功能「批量分诊与交付」：将一批警告意见交给 CLI 校验并应用；审查完成后可生成交付收据，供后续交付检查使用。
boardwise-dsh 的功能「离线绘图编译」：输入 CircuitSpec、PresentationSpec 和符号 profile，可选页面边界及设计意图，返回候选页面、失败项和预览文件。
boardwise-dsh 的功能「绘图回放检查」：提供捕获的页面几何和对应 SVG，可选部件边界框，离线返回发现、计数、阈值和说明。
使用前需在本机安装 Boardwise CLI；可用 BOARDWISE_EXE 指定程序，或让 dsh 进程通过 PATH 找到它。实时工程工具还依赖 EasyEDA Pro connector。

boardwise-dsh README · boardwise：English | [中文](#中文)

An agent harness for hardware engineers.

Current development version: **0.6.1** (prerelease). Published packages are in
[Releases](https://github.com/xianyuyijinban/boardwise/releases).

boardwise-dsh README · boardwise：It lets an AI assistant (Claude Code, DeepSeek, Kimi Code — any of them)
actually read your schematic — components, nets, pins, not screenshots —
and do real work on it: review the board, mark the problems, edit with
your sign-off, export the fab files. EasyEDA Pro is the platform we know
inside-out today; KiCad is next, and the architecture has been
multi-platform from day one.

boardwise-dsh README · What it does：You get a report: ERC/DRC, 23 design rules, which parts
still lack datasheets, and every finding pointing at a concrete
component, pin and net — with markers drawn on the canvas where the
problems are. On real boards it has caught things the designer had
missed — a current-sense circuit with no bias, that kind of problem.
You don't find those by matching rules against a netlist; you have to
check whether the architecture makes sense together. When a rail's
voltage lives only in your head, `intent audit` lists those nets and
asks once; the answer lands in a design-intent contract
(`intent set-rail`) and is never asked again. The PCB review stages
already landed have flagged real layout defects on real boards — a
motor driver's exposed pad whose copper pour was left as a thermal
island on a four-layer FOC driver, that class of problem.

boardwise-dsh README · What it does：**Edit.** Find a problem, get a change preview; nothing moves until you
approve; afterwards it reads back and re-reviews to confirm the problem
is actually gone. Edit kinds today: change a component value, add a
missing part, repair a single pin connection, insert an RC/divider
subcircuit, move a functional block.

boardwise-dsh README · What it does：**Draw.** You state the circuit intent — a divider, an RC low-pass, an
LDO; parts, values, which pin joins which net — and the drawing
compiler turns it into a sheet a human can read: where parts sit, how
wires run, where text goes so it doesn't sit on a wire. Wrong
connectivity, not enough room, a conflict with your locked placement —
it refuses rather than hand you a bad drawing. It compiles offline, and
it can also land into the open editor itself — placement, pin readback
before any wire, save, and a render of the result. Several modules
compose onto one page: what is already on the page becomes keep-outs,
your locked placements are honoured, every rail gets a flag, and one
`draw discard` takes a landed page back off.

boardwise-dsh README · What it does：- **Offline geometry render** — `checkup --file` draws each board to
  `canvas-<board>.svg` (two views, findings highlighted); it is drawn from the
  archived geometry, not a screenshot.
- **`parts accept-unknown`** — an engineer puts on record that a part's unknowns
  are acceptable, so the datasheet gate stops owing it; it is **not** a pass, and
  the conclusion still counts the accepted parts.
- **KiCad bare net ids** — a `(net 3)` with no name is read (as `net#3`) instead
  of the whole board being refused for carrying no net names.
- **V4 and cross-board evidence** — archived V4 projects can review multiple PCBs
  board by board, with duplicate-board and divergent-library refusal. An explicit
  `review <file> --interconnect <declaration.json>` (also on `checkup --file`)
  discloses engineer-declared cross-board ties without merging netlists or moving
  findings and verdicts.
- **Geometry and shelf fixes** — round, oval and non-round elliptical pads are no
  longer all measured as bounding rectangles. The checkout's default parts shelf
  resolves independently of the caller's working directory, and a missing shelf is
  not silently described

boardwise-dsh README · Architecture and roadmap：Three layers, all on your own machine — nothing goes through a cloud:

```
AI assistant
  │  calls short commands (CLI / skill / dsh plugin)
  ▼
offline engine      parse · review rules · drawing compiler · change plans

boardwise-dsh README · Architecture and roadmap：| Stage | Status |
|---|---|
| Schematic review (rule families + datasheet gate + eval harness) | Usable, in maintenance |
| Review-to-local-edit (preview / authorize / readback / re-review) | Usable |
| Drawing compiler (divider / RC / LDO / IC periphery / power entry) | Flyback, CH343 and CH340 example pages have passed their stated connectivity, lint and visual checks; CH343 also passed close/reopen persistence. Arbitrary circuits and CH340 persistence are not claimed |
| PCB review (DRC closure → module-by-module layout → device checks) | Stages A–E done, including device checks and integrated reports; V4 archives support per-PCB review. Real multi-board + library projects and live PCB bitmaps remain uncovered |
| Full schematic capture → PCB generation → SPICE simulation | In that order |
| KiCad platform | Planned |

boardwise-dsh README · Architecture and roadmap：One sentence on how the review rules are scored: the annotated eval
sets are signed and split into a tuning pile and an acceptance pile,
and the harness is built so the acceptance pile cannot leak into the
scores — `--split` defaults to `dev` and holdout records enter no
denominator. Two tuning constants predate the split discipline; their
comments declare their evidence boards, and
`tests/test_doc_claims.py` keeps this paragraph honest.
Details in `outputs/017_generalization.md`.

boardwise-dsh README · Install & supported environments：Three artifacts in [Releases](https://github.com/xianyuyijinban/boardwise/releases):

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `boardwise.exe` | Anyone who doesn't want Python: single-file CLI, part library embedded |
| `boardwise-connector-x.x.x.eext` | Everyone: the extension you import into EasyEDA |
| `boardwise-dsh-x.x.x.tgz` | DeepSeek users: the dsh plugin, optional |

boardwise-dsh README · Install & supported environments：Environment: Windows. Python ≥ 3.10 (source installs only; 3.9 and
below are not supported). EasyEDA Pro **3.2.149 / 3.2.186 / 4.1.60 / 4.1.93**
are all verified on real machines; older versions are not guaranteed.
macOS/Linux are untested — the offline review probably runs, the bridge
is unverified.

boardwise-dsh README · Install & supported environments：Fastest path: [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md) (Chinese — every
step says what you should see). For the impatient: `pip install .` →
import the `.eext` in the editor → `boardwise doctor` all green →
`boardwise checkup`.

boardwise-dsh README · Install & supported environments：Getting the review checklist into your AI: `boardwise install-skill`
installs it for Kimi Code and Claude Code (one side only: `--harness kimi`
or `--harness claude`; a different file already there is backed up to
`SKILL.md.bak-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>`, never quietly replaced, and a second
install on the same day gets its own file rather than displacing the first).
Using another agent —
Codex, Hermes, anything? `boardwise install-skill --agent` prints a short
prompt to paste into your AI, and it puts the file where it looks for
skills, which it knows better than we do. If your AI is working inside a
clone of this repo, [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) already points it at the
checklist — nothing to install.

boardwise-dsh README · Common errors & notes：- **Nothing connects** — nine times out of ten it's one of three: the
  daemon isn't running, the extension's
  *external interaction* permission wasn't granted, or the extension
  never activated. The extension's **About…** menu tells you which.
  The daemon is the one that looks after itself: any command that needs
  the bridge starts one that isn't there and waits for it (the log it
  writes is `${BOARDWISE_HOME:-~/.boardwise}/log/daemon-<date>.log`, and
  the failure it prints names it). If it still is not up, run
  `boardwise bridge start` in the foreground and read what it says;
  `BOARDWISE_NO_AUTO_DAEMON=1` turns the automatic start off for the
  setups that manage it themselves.
- **Several project windows open** — name one: `--project <name>`. It
  refuses to guess.
- **Encrypted `.epro2` export** — unreadable; re-export with encryption
  off.
- **A `.eprj2` file holds no drawing** — it's just the project shell.
  Read live through the bridge, or export an `.epro2` backup.
- **Exit code 3 is not "the board is clean"** — it means the online
  state could not be stated. Whatever could not run is marked
  `{checked: false}` with n

boardwise-dsh README · 中文：硬件工程师的 Agent Harness。

当前开发版本：**0.6.1**（内测）。已发布安装包见
[Releases](https://github.com/xianyuyijinban/boardwise/releases)。

让 AI 助手（Claude Code、DeepSeek、Kimi Code……哪个都行）真正读懂你的
原理图——器件、网络、引脚，不是截图——然后替你干活：审板子、标问题、
按你的授权改图、导出制板文件。目前吃透的是立创 EDA 专业版，KiCad 是
下一个平台，架构从一开始就按多平台设计。

boardwise-dsh README · 它能做什么：**审板子。** 编辑器开着，一条命令：

```bash
boardwise checkup
```

输出一份报告：ERC/DRC、23 条设计规则、哪些器件还缺数据手册、每条问题
各自指着具体的器件、引脚和网络；顺手把问题标记在画布上。它在真板子上
抓到过设计者自己没注意到的问题——比如一个该做偏置而没做的电流采样
电路。这类问题不是查规则书能查出来的，得先理解整个架构自不自洽。
有些电源网的电压只在你脑子里——`intent audit` 会把这些网列出来问一次，
答案用 `intent set-rail` 写进设计意图契约，以后不再问。PCB 审查已落地的
阶段也在真板子上抓到过真缺陷：一块四层 FOC 驱动板上，电机驱动器的
散热焊盘铺铜成了孤岛。

**改图。** 发现问题后，它给修改预览，你点头它才动，动完自己回读、再跑
一遍审查确认问题真的消失。已经支持的改法：改器件值、补一颗缺失的器件、
修单个引脚连接、插入 RC/分压子电路、局部移动一个功能块。

boardwise-dsh README · 它能做什么：**导出。** 一条 `export-fab` 同时出 Gerber、坐标文件和 BOM 三样。
（网表没有单独的导出命令；它在内部读取供审查，不落文件。）

**画图。** 你写电路意图——分压、RC 低通、LDO，器件、参数、哪个脚接
哪个网——画法编译器负责把它变成一张能给人看的图：器件怎么摆、线怎么
走、字放哪不压线。接法错、空间不够、和你的锁定冲突，它宁可拒绝也不交
出一张烂图。离线出图之外，它已经能直接落进开着的编辑器——放件、
拉线前先回读引脚、保存、再出一张渲染图。多个模块能组合进同一页：
页上已有的图元自动变成禁布区、你锁定的位置被尊重、每条电源轨都有
旗标，一条 `draw discard` 能把落好的整页撤下来。

几件新东西值得知道：

boardwise-dsh README · 它能做什么：- **离线几何渲染**——`checkup --file` 给每块板出 `canvas-<board>.svg`（顶/底两个
  视窗、finding 高亮）；它是按归档几何**画**出来的，不是截图。
- **`parts accept-unknown`**——工程师当面记下「这颗器件的未知我接受」，数据手册闸
  不再欠它；它**不是审过**，结论里照样数着这些被接受的器件。
- **KiCad 裸网序号**——没有名字的 `(net 3)` 照读（记成 `net#3`），不再因为一块板
  网名全丢就整盘读不出来。
- **V4 与跨板证据**——V4 归档工程可逐块 PCB 审查，重复 PCB 和分歧库副本会明确拒绝。
  `review <file> --interconnect <声明.json>`（`checkup --file` 同样支持）只披露工程师确认的
  板间连接，不合并网表、不改变 finding 或 verdict。
- **几何与货架修复**——圆盘、`OVAL` 和非圆 `ELLIPSE` 焊盘不再统一按外接矩形量间距；
  默认货架不再受启动目录影响，文件缺失也不会被静默说成「真实空架」。
- **分阶段、可中断的审查**——**一次** `checkup` 之后，先把首轮检查点
  （`initial`/`partial`：环境与版本、`report.conclusion`、ERROR / 宿主 DRC、待确认项、
  产物位置）交付出去，再分批深挖；每批最多 3 条 finding。已有报告可以复读而不必重跑，
  中止的 run 基于已在盘上的产物整理成 `partial`。首轮顺序仍是流程约束；显式
  `checkup --file --strict` 可拒绝同基准重算，`review finalize --strict-partial` 可校验
  四类证据披露。它们都是 opt-in，不代表 harness 级 pre-execute 闸已经实现。

boardwise-dsh README · 架构和规划：三层，全跑在你自己电脑上，不经过任何云端：

```
AI 助手
  │  调很短的命令（CLI / skill / dsh 插件）
  ▼
离线引擎      解析工程文件 · 审查规则 · 画法编译 · 修改计划

规矩就几条：**检查与交付校验**住在工具里；**尚未形成硬闸的编排约束**在 SOP 里明确
披露，不当成工具已自动执行；每个结论带证据；
写操作一律预览 → 授权 → 回读；超时断连先读回，绝不盲目重试。

路线图：

boardwise-dsh README · 架构和规划：| 阶段 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| 原理图审查（规则族 + 数据手册闸 + 评测体系） | 可用，维护中 |
| 审查到局部修改（预览/授权/回读/复查） | 可用 |
| 画法编译器（分压/RC/LDO/IC 外围/电源入口） | 反激、CH343 与 CH340 示例页已通过各自声明的连通、lint 和视觉验收；CH343 另通过关闭重开持久化。任意电路与 CH340 持久化不作承诺 |
| PCB 审查（DRC 闭环 → 按模块布局 → 器件检查） | A–E 阶段完成，含器件检查与整合报告；V4 归档可逐块 PCB 审查。真实多板＋库工程和实时 PCB 位图仍未覆盖 |
| 完整原理图绘制 → PCB 生成 → SPICE 仿真 | 按序推进 |
| KiCad 平台 | 规划中 |

boardwise-dsh README · 架构和规划：审查规则的评测方式说一句人话：我们有一套签名标注过的评测集，分成
调参用和验收用两摞；harness 在结构上堵死验收摞混进分数——`--split` 默认
`dev`，验收摞不进任何分母。有两条调参常量先于分堆制度诞生，它们的注释
里写明了取证板，`tests/test_doc_claims.py` 盯着这段话不许它过期。
细节在 `outputs/017_generalization.md`。

（只装一侧加 `--harness kimi` 或 `--harness claude`；目标位置已有别的版本会先备份成

boardwise-dsh README · 常见错误和注意事项：- **连不上**，九成是三件事之一：daemon 没起、
  扩展的"外部交互"权限没给、扩展没激活。扩展菜单里的 **About…** 会直接
  告诉你卡在哪步。daemon 这一条现在会自己解决：任何需要桥的命令发现它不在，
  自己把它拉起来并等它就绪（它的输出写在
  `${BOARDWISE_HOME:-~/.boardwise}/log/daemon-<日期>.log`，拉起失败时报错会点名这个文件）。
  还是没起来就跑 `boardwise bridge start`（前台运行，原因直接打在窗口里）；
  自己管 daemon 的部署（计划任务/服务）用 `BOARDWISE_NO_AUTO_DAEMON=1` 关掉自动拉起。
- **开了好几个工程窗口**：命令要指名，`--project <名字>`，否则它拒绝猜。
- **`.epro2` 导出时勾了加密**：读不了，重新导一次别勾加密。
- **`.eprj2` 单文件里没有图纸**：那只是工程壳，图纸要么在线走桥读，
  要么导出 `.epro2` 备份。
- **退出码 3 不是"板子干净"**：是**说不清**——在线状态读不出来（daemon 没起、扩展没连上），
  或者 `completion.verdict` 是 `incomplete`（没读到模型 / 有器件缺手册未审 / 骨架没生成 /
  覆盖有缺口）。`review --live` 拿到了模型、但模型是空的（0 器件 0 网络）也算（075）——
  它与"根本没拿到模型"是两句话，两句都不许读成通过。审查没跑成的部分报告里会写
  `{checked: false}`，不带计数。**CI 里别把 3 当通过**（073 起 `review` / `checkup` 都这样；
  有 ERROR 仍是 1，`complete-with-open-items` 仍是 0）。
- **它要改你的图之前**一定会先给预览，别图快跳确认——确认完它自己
  还会回读验证，这一步省不掉也不该省。
- 画布截图在 3.2.186 上返回的是缓存帧，要真实截图请用系统截图工具。
